title: MS Canteen
text:
The Canteen is run by Debashish Da. It is notorious for long waiting times. It is often suggested to order via phone which may take upto 90 mins during peak demand. 

 Timings 
The canteen opens at 7:30 PM and closes based on the crowd by 2:30 AM.
